{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates
data_dedup = data.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify deduplication worked
print("After deduplication, patient_id count:", data_dedup['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Rows after deduplication:", len(data_dedup))

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline in the deduplicated dataset
print("-999 count in biomarker_baseline (after deduplication):", (data_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Now filter to treatment arm only
treatment_arm = data_dedup[data_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check how many responded in treatment arm
responded_count = treatment_arm['responded'].sum()
total_treatment = len(treatment_arm)

print(f"Responded count in treatment arm: {responded_count}")
print(f"Total patients in treatment arm: {total_treatment}")

# Compute fraction
fraction_responded = responded_count / total_treatment
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
